headline: Board approves fund raising of up to Rs. 1,200 crore by way of Qualified Institutions Placement
body_text: The Board of Directors at its meeting held on 09 September, 2026 has approved the raising of funds aggregating up to Rs. 1,200 crore by way of a Qualified Institutions Placement to Qualified Institutional Buyers in accordance with Chapter VI of the SEBI ICDR Regulations. The floor price shall be determined with reference to the relevant date. This disclosure is being made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations.

headline: Intimation of Offer for Sale by Promoter Selling Shareholder
body_text: The Promoter and Promoter Group, Mr. Anand Krishnan, intends to sell up to 2,50,00,000 equity shares representing 6.20% of the total paid-up equity share capital of the Company through an Offer for Sale through the stock exchange mechanism. The floor price for the offer has been fixed at Rs. 745 per equity share. The non-retail investors may place bids on T day.

headline: Disclosure under Regulation 29(2) - Blackstone Capital Partners divested its entire stake
body_text: Blackstone Capital Partners has sold 1,80,00,000 equity shares aggregating Rs. 5,400 crore, representing 8.40% of the paid-up equity capital, through a block deal executed on the stock exchange. Post the transaction the investor has exited the company completely. The transaction was executed at Rs. 3,000 per equity share.

headline: Intimation of Board Meeting to consider fund raising through Rights Issue
body_text: Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on 22 September, 2026 to consider and approve a proposal for raising of funds by way of a Rights Issue of equity shares to the existing shareholders of the Company on a rights basis. The record date for the rights entitlement will be intimated in due course.

headline: Expiry of anchor investor lock-in period
body_text: This is to inform that the lock-in period of 90 days in respect of 1,10,00,000 equity shares allotted to anchor investors in the Initial Public Offering of the Company shall expire on 30 September, 2026. The said shares represent 4.10% of the post-issue paid-up equity share capital.

headline: Preferential allotment of convertible warrants to promoter group
body_text: The Board has approved the preferential issue of 50,00,000 convertible warrants at an issue price of Rs. 210 per warrant, aggregating Rs. 105 crore, to members of the Promoter and Promoter Group on a preferential basis in terms of Regulation 160 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations.

headline: Newspaper publication of unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026
body_text: Please find enclosed copies of the newspaper advertisements published in Business Standard and Navshakti on 11 September, 2026 in respect of the unaudited financial results of the Company. Kindly take the same on record.

headline: Clarification - the Board did not approve the proposed fund raise
body_text: With reference to media reports regarding a proposed QIP, the Company clarifies that the Board did not approve the proposed fund raise and the proposal stands withdrawn. No proposal for capital raising is currently under consideration.

headline: Disclosure of sale of shares by ChrysCapital and General Atlantic
body_text: ChrysCapital and General Atlantic have collectively reduced their shareholding in the Company by way of a secondary sale of 95,00,000 equity shares aggregating approximately Rs. 1,900 crore. The stake sale represents 5.60% of the paid-up equity capital. This constitutes a partial PE exit.

headline: Filing of Draft Red Herring Prospectus with SEBI for Initial Public Offering
body_text: The Company has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India in connection with its proposed Initial Public Offering comprising a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating up to Rs. 2,400 crore and an Offer for Sale of up to 3,00,00,000 equity shares by the selling shareholders including Warburg Pincus.

headline: Allotment of equity shares pursuant to the Initial Public Offering
body_text: The Company has completed its Initial Public Offering. The date of allotment is 10 September, 2026 and the equity shares were listed on 14 September, 2026. Anchor investors including Warburg Pincus were allotted 1,10,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 640 per equity share. The objects of the issue include capital expenditure for setting up of a new manufacturing facility.

headline: Outcome of Extraordinary General Meeting - special resolution for QIP
body_text: The shareholders of the Company approved by way of a special resolution passed at the Extraordinary General Meeting held on 08 September, 2026 the raising of funds aggregating up to Rs. 1,200 crore by way of a Qualified Institutions Placement. The special resolution shall remain valid for a period of 365 days.
